# requires: wire
#
# No Content-Length, no chunked framing, thirty-two bytes and a close. This is
# HTTP/1.0 delimitation and it is indistinguishable on the wire from the same
# transfer cut in half by a network. The digest is the whole defence, which is
# the argument for refusing to deliver a spec that carries neither a size nor a
# digest.
submit A size=64 digest=good src=http:nolength
run A alpha
orphans
state A

# expect 2: transfer-failed state=pending
# expect 2: done=32 err=set [DL-R13]
# expect 3: ok A
